instruction: Enable the minimal view interface mode in VLC media player.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to enable VLC's minimal view mode. This can be done through View menu > Minimal Interface (or Ctrl+H shortcut), or through preferences. The evaluator reads VLC's configuration file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) and checks if 'qt-minimal-view=1' is set, indicating minimal view is enabled.
metadata.similar_to_original: Both tasks involve VLC media player interface configuration. Original task captures video frame for wallpaper (right-click menu), this task enables minimal view mode (View menu or shortcut). Similar difficulty with simple menu navigation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: getter reads VLC config file (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc) and metric checks for 'qt-minimal-view=1' setting
Complete coverage: instruction has one requirement (enable minimal view mode) and evaluator checks exactly that
Correct parameter handling: metric correctly accesses expected['minimal_view_enabled'] directly when expected.type='rule' (framework returns rules dict directly)
Platform-aware implementation: getter handles Linux/Darwin/Windows config file paths correctly
Proper default handling: metric defaults to '0' (disabled) if setting not found in config file
Expected value is semantically correct: minimal_view_enabled=1 represents the enabled state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding explicit config file existence check in getter before reading to provide better error handling
